method.label: multi-target sector rotation relative to CSI All Share
method.estimator: independent rolling ridge logistic/linear models for 1, 5 and 20 sessions
method.validation: purged walk-forward time-series validation with horizon embargo
method.calibration: Platt calibration is enabled only after raw OOS discrimination and dispersion checks
method.fallback: strict abstention; evidence observation ranking replaces failed probability publication
method.focusPolicy: deeper collection never changes model priors, feature weights or scores
